viewing_check: Estimate 80-140, current bid $30 (22% premium on top). Three new-with-tags genuine Liberty London shirts, 17 inch collar, so a large fit. Single shirts sell A$50-125 (new with tags at the top, A$65-123), so a lot of three is worth roughly A$190-330 if sold as three separate listings. Check tags and collar size on the day, and that they are sealed and unworn. Prices are 2024-2026, rising a little in 2026. Third-party Liberty-print brands (Sportscraft, Country Road) sell lower at A$30-60 and were not used.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU sold: 'liberty tana lawn mens shirt' (6), 'liberty london shirt mens' (21), 'liberty tana lawn shirt new tags' (0), 'liberty tana lawn shirt' (50, mainly Sportscraft womens). Terapeak GB: 'liberty london tana lawn shirt men' (36 rows, used 10). Google for retail price.
flip_reason: About 10 comparable single-shirt sales, typical A$60-100, new with tags A$65-123; three shirts perhaps A$200-300 sold separately but 17in collar limits buyers. Current bid $30 so potential profit exceeds $200 only if bids stay under about $60 hammer; check it closer to the close.
